name: Websites - Authorized - Gen AI Domains - CAU [is]
description: Intent: Authorized GenAI domains where Cloud App User (CAU) identity is captured by the agent — populate with sanctioned GenAI services your users are licensed for (e.g., chatgpt.com, claude.ai, m365.cloud.microsoft, gemini.google.com, github.com/copilot). Drives the Authorized split on D1010 / M1010 and is negated to define the Unauthorized GenAI surface on D1011 / M1011 / W1011 / B1010 / B1030. Top priority — foundational for GenAI risk segmentation. Exclusions: do not add domains that lack CAU enrichment (use the No-CAU sibling list); do not add personal-account GenAI surfaces — those should fall into Unauthorized so warn/block paths fire.
